market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Bond yield spike and oil above $103 create headwinds for equities, but AI/tech momentum and US-China truce provide support. Expect range-bound action with sector rotation from rate-sensitive to energy/quality. Key trigger: 10Y yield above 4.8% could trigger broader risk-off.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but cautious. AI capex cycle and US-China normalization support 6-12 month equity upside. However, inflation re-acceleration (PMI, oil) may force Fed to 4.75%+, compressing valuations. Structural themes: AI adoption, energy transition, EM diversification, crypto institutionalization.

watch_list: Fed funds futures implied rate path
